name: Locate SSD updater
command: set -u; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@clementine.whatbox.ca 'find /mnt/nvme11n1/artemisprime/Upload-Assistant-wastaken -maxdepth 4 -type f -iname "*ua*update*" -print'
description: Locate the Clementine-specific UA update script.
